output.answer: NewsBreak is not owned by any single person or public parent company — it is the trade name of privately held Particle Media, Inc., a Delaware-incorporated, venture-backed company headquartered in Mountain View, California. Founder and CEO Jeff Zheng (Zhaohui Zheng), a former Yahoo executive who started the company in 2015, runs it and holds a significant though undisclosed equity stake; former Microsoft AI chief Harry Shum has chaired the board since 2020. The largest institutional investor is US private-equity firm Francisco Partners, which led the $115 million Series C in January 2021 (valuing NewsBreak at roughly $1 billion) and took a board seat, alongside earlier backers such as IDG Capital, NetEase, ZhenFund and Grand View Capital. As a private company it has never gone public and exact ownership percentages are not disclosed.
caveats: NewsBreak is private, so precise ownership percentages for Jeff Zheng and each investor are not publicly disclosed; his stake is described as significant but unconfirmed.
The ~$1 billion valuation dates to the January 2021 Series C; no newer official valuation has been confirmed as of late 2026.

The app's Chinese origins (it launched as the US version of Yidian Zixun, with early IDG Capital backing) continue to draw US lawmaker and national-security scrutiny, which could affect ownership or structure; reporting found no evidence NewsBreak censored content or promoted news favorable to the Chinese government.
Yidian Zixun, an early shareholder in Particle Media, reportedly divested its stake in 2019.

**MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif., Jan. 07, 2021 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --** News Break, The Nation’s No. 1 Intelligent Local News App, today announced it has closed a $115 million round in Series C funding led by Francisco Partners, a leading global investment firm that specializes in partnering with technology businesses. Francisco Partners will gain a seat on News Break’s Board of Directors. The investment makes News Break one of the first new unicorns of 2021.

key_facts.fact: NewsBreak's legal name is Particle Media, Inc.; the company is active and for-profit, with NewsBreak as its trade name (also known as News Break).
NewsBreak is a private company (never gone public), founded in 2015 by Jeff Zheng, who is also CEO.

Ownership is concentrated among founders, employees with equity, and venture investors through parent company Particle Media, Inc.; founder-CEO Jeff Zheng holds a significant but undisclosed stake, and the largest institutional investor is Francisco Partners, which led the 2021 Series C and holds a board seat; IDG Capital is a notable early backer.

News Break closed a $115 million Series C led by Francisco Partners, which gained a board seat, making it one of the first new unicorns of 2021; it had previously raised more than $36 million from investors including IDG Capital.
News Break was founded in Silicon Valley in 2015 by ex-Yahoo executive Jeff Zheng, with Yahoo co-founder Jerry Yang as advisor; Harry Shum joined as Chairman of the Board in 2020.

NewsBreak's own site today describes the company as led by founder and CEO Jeff Zheng, headquartered in Mountain View with offices in Seattle and New York, serving more than 40 million people a month.
Yidian Zixun (一点资讯), the Chinese news aggregator from which NewsBreak launched as its US version, was Particle Media's early investor and divested its stake in 2019.
